trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was the unhealthy release running everywhere, with an error rate of 0.18. v2.3.0 is the most recent production release marked healthy, and it had already run in production, so no change-manager approval was needed.
- **Current state:** checkout-api is healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, with an error rate of 0.002.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback, and the post-rollback state. It also notes that v2.3.1 needs investigation and should not be redeployed without change-manager approval, since it has never been healthy in production.

The first attempt to open the incident hit a rate limit, and the retry succeeded. The retry used an idempotency key, so the incident should not be duplicated.
